description: This file defines the KeyboardPrefs class, which provides static methods to access keyboard-related preferences such as default domain, hiding language key, and layout overrides within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: KeyboardPrefs
classes.description: A utility class for accessing keyboard preferences in the application.

methods.name: getDefaultDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the default domain string from preferences, trims whitespace.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Helper method to get a string preference value given a context, preference key, and default value.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Helper method to get a boolean preference value given a context, preference key, and default value.

methods.name: alwaysHideLanguageKey
methods.description: Returns whether the language key should always be hidden based on preferences.

methods.name: disallowGenericRowOverride
methods.description: Returns whether overriding of generic rows is disallowed based on preferences.
